title: Artifacts
description: A catalog of your claude.ai artifacts: those your tower workers publish, recorded as they do, and those you import from Claude Desktop's Cowork and the claude.ai gallery. Each keeps its creation context, so any worker can modify or clone one without starting over, and the ones you pin stay on top.

guidance.brief: claude.ai artifacts catalog: each one you publish is recorded; write its context when asked (`tower x artifacts context`). `tower kept artifacts` lists them, `tower read <tag>` one.
guidance.full:
Every artifact a worker publishes with the Artifact tool is recorded in the tower-wide `artifacts` collection by this extension's hook, which then asks you to write its creation context. Do it right away, while you hold it: `tower x artifacts context <id> <<'EOF'` … `EOF`, saying what it is for, who asked and why, the data and sources it draws on, the choices made and what was ruled out, and how it is built. Another worker will modify or clone it from that alone.

When the user's prompt links an artifact, names its entry's tag or its whole title, the hook has already shown its page beside you and said which entry it is. When they refer to one more loosely ("the roadmap"), find it in `tower kept artifacts` (each entry's `.md`, its page the `.html` beside it) and `tower show <its .html>` before you answer.

To work on an existing artifact, read its entry first (`tower kept artifacts`, then `tower read <tag>`), then the page with the Artifact tool's `read`; publish to its `url` to change it, without one to make a new one. To keep a page, so the gallery shows it and `tower show` can: `tower x artifacts page <id> --file <saved.html>`. To import: `tower x artifacts desktop` reads Claude Desktop's Cowork artifacts on this machine; for the claude.ai gallery, list it with the Artifact tool and add each with `tower x artifacts add --url <link> --title <title> --updated <iso>`. `tower x artifacts pin <id>` and `unpin <id>` keep the important ones on top. The `artifacts:import` and `artifacts:work` skills hold the steps.
